input.description: A complete saved flop-to-river game on Kc Td 4h at 100bb initial depth, with a 24bb pot and 88bb behind. The smaller pot leaves room for non-all-in pot raises and multi-street pot building. The declared ranges include an overpair, a set, top pairs and broadway straight draws. Half-pot, pot, all-in and one subsequent raise are modeled across all three streets.
input.rangeAssumptions: Illustrative starting ranges: BTN AA/KQs/QJs and BB TT/KJs/AQs, equal weight per unblocked exact combination. These are declared study assumptions, not certified preflop frequencies or outputs of a solved earlier betting line. Every later action and ordered card arrival uses one jointly solved conditional flop-to-river game. This does not certify full-hand Hold'em or activate a universal 100bb model. Rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
